verdicts.note: as ... as の間は原級。tall。
than があるので比較級 heavier。
the ... in Japan で最上級 highest。
than があるので比較級。difficult は more difficult。
Health is more important than money. 比較対象は無冠詞 money。
the most popular で最上級。most。
not as ... as は原級 big。
good の比較級 better。than あり。
the best ... I have ever seen で最上級 best。
much + 比較級。hot→hotter。much は比較級強調。
than I do で比較級 faster。
one of the + 最上級 + 複数名詞。oldest。
The more ..., the more ... 構文。先頭は The more。
比較級 and 比較級 で「ますます」。warmer and warmer。
No other ... as ... as は原級 kind。

verdicts.produced_sentence: She swims as fast as me.
verdicts.note: as fast as の原級比較。トークンに me が与えられているため as ... as me で確定。

verdicts.produced_sentence: This book is more interesting than that one.
verdicts.note: more interesting than の比較級構文。

verdicts.produced_sentence: He is the tallest student in the class.
verdicts.note: the tallest student in the class の最上級。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Tokyo is one of the largest cities in Japan.
verdicts.note: one of the largest cities in Japan の構文。

verdicts.produced_sentence: This question is much easier than that one.
verdicts.note: much easier than の比較級強調。
Ken is taller than Mike. を主語Mike+shorterで反転。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Your bike is newer than my bike.
verdicts.multiple_valid_note: 末尾を my bike とするのが原文対応だが、Your bike is newer than mine. も同義で文法的に成立する。
verdicts.note: 主語your bike+newerで反転。

verdicts.produced_sentence: That river is not as long as this river.
verdicts.multiple_valid_note: That river is not so long as this river. も not so ... as の形で成立。
verdicts.note: longer than → 主語that river + not as long as。

verdicts.produced_sentence: No other girl in the village is as beautiful as Ann.
verdicts.note: 最上級→No other ... as ... as の原級書き換え。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Soccer is the most popular sport in this class.
verdicts.note: any other 比較級→the most 最上級。
